mechanism_class: resource-cost redirection: self-damage skill-cost paid by a proxy entity's life pool (not the caster)
spec_text_or_path: Forbidden Rite's identity is that the spell COSTS THE CASTER LIFE (enough to kill them) but, when cast THROUGH totems, the life-cost is PAID BY THE TOTEM ENTITIES instead of the player -- the totems bleed so the caster stays safe (Soul Mantle + Hierophant totem chassis). The engine can model an hp-cost on a skill (resource_economy.hp_cost_scale, LOCKED <=0.30) and can model totem-proxy delivery (PROXY_ASCENSION), but it has NO primitive to REDIRECT a skill's self-damage-cost onto a proxy entity's life pool. Mapped as totem-proxy delivery + a capped hp-cost on the chassis (grade APPROX), which loses the cost-laundering that IS the build's safety identity. Would require either (a) a 'cost-payer = proxy-entity' resource-redirection primitive (proxy pays the hp/life price a skill would otherwise charge the caster), or (b) an explicit ruling that the outsourcing is flavor-only and 'hp-cost on the chassis + totem delivery' is the canonical approximation. Ladder audit: map (hp_cost lane exists) -> approx (cost lands on caster not totem, noted, grade APPROX) -> quantitative mint? NO (not a range/count extension of an existing param) -> qualitative mint-candidate? this is a NEW mechanism (cost-payer redirection) so it is evidence-gated; filed to docket for steward ruling on whether it is minted or declared flavor-approximation.

mechanism_class: damage-model gap: stun-magnitude AS the damage source (stun-scaling), plus relentless perma-stunlock against an engine that deliberately prevents it
spec_text_or_path: Heavy Strike Stun's identity is TWO-fold and both halves lack an engine lane: (1) DAMAGE SCALES OFF THE STUN MODEL -- the build stacks ~75% reduced-enemy-stun-threshold and its damage is computed from stun magnitude/buildup; the engine's `stun` ailment (ailments.yaml: physical+lightning hard-control) is a CROWD-CONTROL primitive, NOT a damage source, and there is no T4 strategy for 'convert stun buildup into damage'. (2) RELENTLESS STUN-LOCK -- the build's feel is chain-stunning everything; but the engine stun ailment carries a DELIBERATE anti-stunlock floor (immunity_after_seconds, min 1.0s HARD guard 'prevent perma-stun via rapid re-apply') and boss stun-resistance, so the engine STRUCTURALLY refuses the perma-stun the build is built around. Mapped as melee_strike + stun ailment + the nearest T4 (MOMENTUM_CASCADE, a build-up-to-payoff reading), grade APPROX -- captures 'a heavy melee that stuns' but loses BOTH the stun-as-damage model and the stunlock feel. Would require either (a) a 'control-magnitude-as-damage-source' strategy (stun/freeze buildup converts to a damage payoff) -- a genuinely new capstone class, evidence-gated; or (b) a ruling that stun stays CC-flavor and the damage rides normal scaling, accepting the identity loss. NOTE: low source confidence compounds this (post-cutoff 3.28 kit; delivery/econ conf 0.3-0.4, econ 'unknown') -- the gap should be re-checked if a deeper dossier lands. Ladder audit: map (stun ailment + melee exist) -> approx (stun becomes CC-flavor not damage; MOMENTUM_CASCADE nearest door, noted, grade APPROX) -> quantitative mint? NO -> qualitative mint-candidate (control-as-damage-source) filed to docket for steward ruling.
